title: Shoreline: quick launch-day scratch & edits
content:
Morning sprint capture (quick, noisy notes)

Top intent for today: finish PRD final edits, confirm canary config + rollback, align comms + support runbook. Keep this file minimal — copy items into tickets/Confluence after morning sync.

MORNING PRIORITIES (today)
- Final PRD edits to acceptance criteria + add performance guardrails (see edits below).
- Lock canary percentage and schedule with infra (Target: 5% traffic for 2h, escalate to 25% at +4h if no errors).
- Confirm dedicated vs shared model routing behavior for Hosted customers (note for docs).
- Create Postmortem checklist template for rollout regressions.

PRD EDITS (specific lines to change)
- Section: "Failure Modes" — add explicit latency SLA degradation behavior: if p95 latency > 2.2x baseline for 10 minutes, auto-failover to smaller quantized model and open INF-5170.
- Acceptance criteria: replace vague "no major regressions" with concrete regression signals: "embedding cosine drop > 0.08 on eval-set OR generation BLEU-like drop > 4 points". Link to evaluation harness in Confluence.
- Rollout steps: insert step to validate KV-cache warming metrics in first 30 minutes (metric: kv_cache_hit_ratio > 0.6).
- Add a field for "observability owner" (assign to Samir) and list contact escalation path (pager + Slack).

STAKEHOLDER FOLLOW-UPS (who to ping)
- Engineering (Ethan): need confirmation on canary traffic throttling knob. Ping 10:15 standup.
- Infra (Samir): confirm autoscaler cooldown and ability to pin a fallback model instance.
- Design (Priya): quick sanity check on UI copy for feature flag exposure — small change to wording on rollout banner.
- CS (Lina): pre-write FAQ bullets for customers likely to see degraded quality during canary. Add to release notes.

LAUNCH READINESS CHECKLIST (quick yes/no)
- [ ] Canary config in infra (traffic %, duration) — owner: Ethan.
- [ ] Rollback plan documented + automated toggle — owner: Samir.
- [ ] Runbook created (steps, contacts, dashboard links) — owner: Maya (draft) / Samir (review).
- [ ] Eval regression baseline uploaded and pinned — owner: research.
- [ ] Billing & quota guardrails (prevent huge cost exposure) — owner: finance ops.
- [ ] User-facing comms drafted (release notes + customer email) — owner: growth.

NOTES TO SELF / QUICK ACTIONS
- 09:30 quick sync with Ethan + Samir (15m). Bring the canary numbers preproposal.
- 11:00 review PRD with Priya — highlight copy changes and acceptance criteria.
- After lunch: write short runbook skeleton (bullet list), push to Confluence and link from PRD.
- End of day: snapshot canary metrics dashboard and save to release folder.

BLOCKERS / OPEN QUESTIONS
- Does Dedicated capacity honor the same fallback policies as Hosted? If not, need to call this out in PRD. (Open: INF-5170 assigned).
- Is there a quick way for support to flag a customer for manual model pinning? If not, add feature request to solutions-engineering backlog.
- What are the legal/regulatory notes for APAC customers moving to private deployments during canary? Ask security/compliance.

SNIPPET: suggested canary parameters (proposed)
- Start: 5% of traffic, 2 hours monitoring window, rollback if error rate > 1% or latency p95 > 2.2x baseline.
- Escalate to 25% for 4 hours if steady; full roll at 24h if no regression signals.

COPY / COMMUNICATIONS (draft bullet points)
- "We’re rolling out a controlled update to our generation pipeline to improve latency and cost. A subset of traffic will see the new model; we will monitor quality metrics and roll back if needed."
- FAQ bullets for CS: expected small quality variance during canary; contact support with examples; we will pin model variant per-customer if needed.

RETRO NOTES (for after launch, placeholder)
- Capture time-to-detect for first regression signal.
- Capture who executed rollback and latency of rollback.
- Cost delta during first 6h.

LINKS TO ATTACH POST-SYNC
- Confluence PRD (will paste link)
- Dashboard: /grafana/d/shoreline-canary
- Jira: API-4821 (feature), INF-5170 (infra followup)
- GH PR: infra/pull/328 (autoscaler fixes)

End of scratch — copy items into tickets and Confluence after 11:00 sync. Keep this file as the single-source quick log for launch day decisions.

Random micro-thoughts: breathe. Keep runbook short; ops will expand. If Priya pushes UI wording, prioritize clarity over cleverness.
